title: Netflix Makes Its Texas Book Festival Debut; Featuring “The Netflix Effect on Book Adaptations” Panel, Early Screening of 'Guarding Stars' and a Pop-Up Reading Lounge
body_markdown:
#


\[ Virgin River


showrunner and authors behind


The Hunting Wives


and


Guarding Stars


take the stage alongside book signings, coffee, and swag at the Netflix Reading Lounge


For the first time, Netflix is coming to the


[Texas Book Festival](https://texasbookfestival.org/) in Austin, TX on November 14-15 with a weekend built around the books behind your favorite Netflix stories.


The lineup includes a


[panel](https://texasbookfestival.org/schedule/book-to-screen-how-netflix-brings-heartland-stories-to-global-audiences/) on The Netflix Effect and cultural impact on heartland book adaptations, featuring


Virgin River


showrunner Patrick Sean Smith,


The Hunting Wives


author May Cobb,


The Bodyguard


author Katherine Center whose bestselling novel is the inspiration for the upcoming film


Guarding Stars


, and Netflix Vice President of Drama Cole Galvin, moderated by


Cosmopolitan


’s


[Tamara Fuentes](https://www.cosmopolitan.com/author/208802/tamara-fuentes/) ; an early


[special screening](https://texasbookfestival.org/schedule/netflix-presents-a-special-screening-of-guarding-stars/) of


Guarding Stars


; author book signings; and the Netflix Reading Lounge, a cozy downtown Austin hangout with free books, coffee and swag.


Festival attendees can also hear


[Cobb](https://texasbookfestival.org/directory/author/may-cobb/) discuss her new novel,


All the Little Houses


, and


[Center](https://texasbookfestival.org/directory/author/katherine-center/) share her new novel,


The Shippers


. The festival is free and open to the public, Saturday from 10 am to 5 pm and Sunday from 11 am to 5 pm.


Here’s everything we have planned:


The Netflix Effect: How Book-to-Screen Adaptations Are Capturing the Heartland


Saturday, November 14 | 3-3:45 pm CT | State Theatre, 719 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 From Texas landscapes to a small town in Northern California, some of today’s most beloved screen adaptations started as novels set in close-knit communities across the American heartland. Join


Cosmopolitan


’s Tamara Fuentes for a conversation with Patrick Sean Smith (


[Virgin River](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/virgin-river) ), May Cobb (


[The Hunting Wives](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/the-hunting-wives-season-2-trailer) ), Katherine Center (


[Guarding Stars](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/leighton-meester-jared-padalecki-bodyguard-adaptation-cast-news-movie-name) inspired by her bestselling novel


[The Bodyguard](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/leighton-meester-jared-padalecki-bodyguard-adaptation-cast-news-movie-name) ), and Netflix Vice President of Drama Cole Galvin as they discuss bringing these stories to life on screen, and the cultural impact that follows its premiere on Netflix.


Book Signings with May Cobb and Katherine Center


Saturday, November 14 | 4 pm CT | Netflix Reading Lounge, 920 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 Right after the panel, Cobb and Center will sign copies of


The Hunting Wives


and


The Bodyguard


. Stop by for a signature, free coffee and swag.


Netflix Presents: A Special Screening of


Guarding Stars


Sunday, November 15 | 5-6:30 pm CT | State Theatre, 719 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 Be among the first to see


Guarding Stars


, starring Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki, based on Center’s bestselling novel


The Bodyguard


.


[Reserve your spot on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/netflix-texas-book-festival-present-a-special-screening-of-guarding-stars-tickets-2003798808176?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true) .


Netflix Reading Lounge


All weekend | 920 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 Your cozy stop between sessions. Take home a Netflix tote bag, customize a bookmark, order free coffee inspired by your favorite books and pick up free books, including the new movie tie-in cover of


The Hunting Wives


. Browse the books behind Netflix favorites like


Virgin River


,


The Hunting Wives


,


The Bodyguard


,


East of Eden


,


Pride & Prejudice


,


The Chronicles of Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew


,


In a Holidaze


and more.


We can't wait to see you there!
